entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: candidate Diablo 3D item modeling turnaround.
Subject: ONE Wizardspike, item.design.unique.wizardspike, cursor 50. The supplied PRIVATE ORIGINAL sprite is silhouette, proportion and local-color reference only. Reconstruct its actual slender steel dagger: a narrow gently sinuous blade ending in a small pointed tip, shallow warm-brass U guard with short upward tips, very short dark navy-blue wrapped grip and small plain brass pommel. Preserve its modest scale and blade/grip proportions. No motifs invented from the name.
Sheet: FRONT, thin SIDE, BACK, THREE-QUARTER and a small freshly rendered HD inventory preview of the same object. Entire object visible in every view. BACK is the opposite flat face and horizontally mirrors the subtly asymmetric sinuous blade; guard, grip and pommel must agree in all views. Conservative plausible thickness and rear construction, no design variants.
Realistic worn silver steel, aged brass and navy leather. Opaque charcoal-gray background, soft neutral white studio light, restrained wear. Labels only WIZARDSPIKE / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON. No magic, glow, jewels, wizard decoration, hands, scenery or watermark. Never paste, trace or display any pixel sprite in the output; the thumbnail is a new HD render of this candidate.
entries.notes: Opposite-face blade curvature/hooks mirror correctly on visual inspection. Thickness, guard depth, grip wrapping and rear details inferred; not an approval or proof of 3D coherence. New thumbnail is a concept preview, not a runtime icon.
